methodology: Verse-level preliminary triage against Quran 6:131-140 and provisional earlier text locators. No original-language critical-edition or manuscript verification; all candidate links hidden from public.

entries.summary: Destruction of communities and prior warning

staged_candidates.comparison: Jeremiah describes a conditional warning of national destruction and repentance; Qur'an 6:131 stresses that communities are not destroyed while unaware.

entries.caveat: Passage locator is a research lead, not original-language/critical-edition and witness verification. No direct dependence claimed.

entries.summary: Allocation of produce and livestock to God and alleged partners

entries.summary: Killing children presented as religiously acceptable
